rooms.description: In 2025, a game designer named Peb had a dream about coding a game engine. So they did. It was free and it was cool. It was called 'nswengine'

It had a simple layout - games were made up of rooms. Each room contained some text, and up to four links to other rooms in four directions: North, South, East and West. It was easy to understand, quick to create prototypes, and the directional component made it easy for players to grasp and navigate interactive fiction - a genre often not anchored in physical space.
Some May or early June of 2026, Peb disappeared. All of his accounts were deleted - including github and itch.io, where the nswengine was hosted.
I was able to recover some of the files, and I am hosting them myself in an attempt to perserve this piece of interactive art. Peb, if you see this, I hope you will come back one day!
